_note: Query set for the immune-architecture / antigen-class sweep (2026-08-07). Consumed by scripts/lit_batch_probe.py on a GitHub Actions runner; nothing here is committed output.

europepmc.label: EMC tumour microenvironment / immune
europepmc.q: ("extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma" OR "extra-skeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma") AND (immune OR immunotherapy OR "tumor microenvironment" OR "tumour microenvironment" OR PD-L1 OR lymphocyte)

europepmc.label: EMC sunitinib / nivolumab / ImmunoSarc
europepmc.q: ("extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma" OR "extra-skeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma") AND (sunitinib OR nivolumab OR IMMUNOSARC OR antiangiogenic)

europepmc.label: EMC matrix / proteoglycan / chondroitin sulfate
europepmc.q: ("extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma" OR "myxoid chondrosarcoma") AND (proteoglycan OR "chondroitin sulfate" OR glycosaminoglycan OR hyaluronan OR matrix)

europepmc.label: oncofetal chondroitin sulfate / VAR2CSA - all
europepmc.q: "oncofetal chondroitin sulfate" OR VAR2CSA OR rVAR2 OR vartumab

europepmc.label: ofCS / VAR2CSA in sarcoma or mesenchymal tumours
europepmc.q: (VAR2CSA OR "oncofetal chondroitin sulfate" OR "placental-like chondroitin sulfate") AND (sarcoma OR mesenchymal OR chondrosarcoma OR osteosarcoma OR bone)

europepmc.label: CSPG4 sarcoma / chondrosarcoma immunotherapy
europepmc.q: (CSPG4 OR "melanoma-associated chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan" OR HMW-MAA OR NG2) AND (sarcoma OR chondrosarcoma) AND (CAR OR antibody OR immunotherapy OR expression)

europepmc.label: peptide-centric CAR / PC-CAR
europepmc.q: "peptide-centric" AND (CAR OR "chimeric antigen receptor")

europepmc.label: PHOX2B CAR / intracellular oncoprotein peptide-HLA CAR clinical
europepmc.q: (PHOX2B OR "intracellular oncoprotein") AND ("chimeric antigen receptor" OR CAR) AND (peptide OR HLA)

europepmc.label: HIT receptors / TRuC / STAR-T synthetic receptors
europepmc.q: "HLA-independent T cell receptor" OR "HLA-independent TCR" OR "T cell receptor fusion construct" OR TRuC OR "synthetic T cell receptor and antigen receptor" OR "STAR-T"

europepmc.label: TCR-mimic antibodies peptide-HLA
europepmc.q: ("TCR mimic" OR "TCR-mimic" OR "TCR-like antibody") AND (peptide-MHC OR "peptide-HLA" OR immunotherapy)

europepmc.label: SynNotch / logic-gated CAR B7-H3 selectivity
europepmc.q: (synNotch OR "logic-gated" OR "AND gate" OR "priming receptor" OR LINK) AND ("chimeric antigen receptor" OR CAR) AND (B7-H3 OR CD276 OR selectivity OR "on-target off-tumor")

europepmc.label: CAR macrophage matrix / stroma / clinical
europepmc.q: ("CAR macrophage" OR "CAR-M" OR "chimeric antigen receptor macrophage") AND (solid OR matrix OR stroma OR clinical OR trial)

europepmc.label: in vivo CAR-T LNP mRNA
europepmc.q: ("in vivo CAR" OR "in vivo chimeric antigen receptor") AND ("lipid nanoparticle" OR mRNA OR LNP)

europepmc.label: HERV / cryptic ORF / non-canonical antigens in sarcoma
europepmc.q: (HERV OR "endogenous retrovirus" OR cryptic OR "non-canonical" OR "dark antigen") AND (immunopeptidome OR "HLA ligandome" OR neoantigen) AND (sarcoma OR Ewing OR synovial OR mesenchymal OR pediatric)

europepmc.label: splicing / intron retention neoantigens
europepmc.q: (splicing OR "intron retention" OR "alternative splicing") AND (neoantigen OR neoepitope) AND (tumor OR tumour)

europepmc.label: FET fusion EWSR1 splicing dysregulation
europepmc.q: (EWSR1 OR "EWS-FLI1" OR "EWSR1::FLI1" OR FET) AND ("alternative splicing" OR spliceosome OR "splicing factor") AND (fusion OR sarcoma)

europepmc.label: NR4A3 EWSR1 fusion transcriptome splicing EMC
europepmc.q: NR4A3 AND (EWSR1 OR TAF15 OR TCF12 OR TFG) AND (transcriptome OR "RNA-seq" OR splicing OR expression)

europepmc.label: ED-B fibronectin L19 immunocytokine sarcoma
europepmc.q: ("ED-B" OR "extra domain B" OR L19 OR onfekafusp OR Fibromun) AND (fibronectin OR immunocytokine) AND (sarcoma OR TNF OR IL2)

europepmc.label: tenascin-C targeting sarcoma
europepmc.q: "tenascin-C" AND (antibody OR CAR OR immunocytokine OR radioimmunotherapy) AND (tumor OR tumour OR sarcoma)

europepmc.label: intratumoral STING / TLR agonist sarcoma
europepmc.q: (STING agonist OR "TLR9 agonist" OR "TLR7 agonist" OR intratumoral OR intratumoural) AND sarcoma AND (immunotherapy OR checkpoint OR abscopal)

europepmc.label: oncolytic virus sarcoma
europepmc.q: (oncolytic OR "talimogene laherparepvec" OR "T-VEC") AND sarcoma AND (trial OR phase OR pembrolizumab)

europepmc.label: radiotherapy + checkpoint sarcoma in situ vaccine
europepmc.q: (radiotherapy OR radiation OR cryoablation) AND (pembrolizumab OR nivolumab OR "checkpoint") AND sarcoma AND (trial OR abscopal OR "in situ vaccine")

europepmc.label: alveolar soft part sarcoma immune mechanism
europepmc.q: "alveolar soft part sarcoma" AND (atezolizumab OR immune OR "tumor microenvironment" OR vascular OR angiogenesis OR TFE3)

europepmc.label: epigenetic viral mimicry + immunotherapy sarcoma
europepmc.q: ("viral mimicry" OR DNMT OR decitabine OR guadecitabine OR azacitidine OR "HDAC inhibitor") AND (sarcoma OR "translocation") AND (immune OR checkpoint OR interferon)

europepmc.label: gamma delta T cells sarcoma
europepmc.q: ("gamma delta T" OR "Vgamma9Vdelta2" OR "Vdelta1") AND (sarcoma OR osteosarcoma OR Ewing) AND (therapy OR CAR OR clinical)

europepmc.label: CAR-NK and iNKT solid tumour / sarcoma
europepmc.q: ("CAR-NK" OR "CAR NK" OR "invariant natural killer T" OR iNKT) AND (sarcoma OR "solid tumor" OR "solid tumour") AND (trial OR clinical OR preclinical)

europepmc.label: Tn STn truncated O-glycan CAR
europepmc.q: ("Tn antigen" OR "STn" OR "sialyl-Tn" OR "truncated O-glycan" OR Tn-MUC1) AND (CAR OR antibody OR immunotherapy)

europepmc.label: glycocalyx / chondroitin sulfate immune exclusion barrier
europepmc.q: ("chondroitin sulfate" OR glycosaminoglycan OR glycocalyx OR "extracellular matrix") AND ("immune exclusion" OR "T cell infiltration" OR "immune evasion" OR barrier) AND (tumor OR tumour)

europepmc.label: TIL therapy sarcoma
europepmc.q: ("tumor infiltrating lymphocyte" OR TIL OR lifileucel) AND (sarcoma OR "soft tissue") AND (therapy OR trial)

europepmc.label: hyaluronidase PEGPH20 / matrix degradation to aid immunotherapy
europepmc.q: (hyaluronidase OR PEGPH20 OR chondroitinase OR "matrix degradation") AND ("T cell" OR CAR OR immunotherapy OR penetration)
